# AI Roleplay Guides, by the Lunafic team

> Plain guides to AI roleplay and interactive stories, written by the team behind Lunafic (https://lunafic.ai), an AI roleplay app. Every guide states the date its facts were last checked and lists Lunafic's own limits.
